content_blocks.title: Why this matters
content_blocks.text: Reliable data work combines diagnosis, explicit assignment, equality checks, and tests that catch changes over time.

content_blocks.title: Core idea
content_blocks.text: With Copy-on-Write, a derived Series or DataFrame behaves as an independent object from the user perspective. Update the object you intend to change directly (for example with `.loc[...] = ...`) rather than relying on chained assignment to mutate an original.

content_blocks.code:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({"score": [10, 20]})
df.loc[0, "score"] = 99
print(df["score"].tolist())

content_blocks.title: Common mistakes and fixes

common_mistakes.problem: Assuming older Pandas dtype or assignment behavior still applies.
common_mistakes.why: Major-version changes can alter inferred string types and mutation behavior.
common_mistakes.fix: Test against the target version and read the corresponding migration guide.
